The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2009 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2010 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams. ==Format== The format for both championships are identical. Each championship will have two stages: a first stage and a playoff stage. The first stage of each championship is a double round-robin format. The teams that finishes 1 and 2 in the standings will advance to the payoffs semifinals, while the teams that finish 3–6 will enter in the quarterfinals. The winner of each quarterfinals will advance to the semifinals.
